title.zh: 全球资金转移网络Thunes与Coinbase宣布达成战略合作
title.en: 全球资金转移网络Thunes与Coinbase宣布达成战略合作

current_state.zh: Coinbase and Thunes announced a strategic partnership to combine fiat and digital-asset infrastructure, integrating Thunes' local clearing network into Coinbase and using Coinbase's stablecoin solutions to expand real-time cross-border payouts.
current_state.en: Coinbase and Thunes announced a strategic partnership to combine fiat and digital-asset infrastructure, integrating Thunes' local clearing network into Coinbase and using Coinbase's stablecoin solutions to expand real-time cross-border payouts.
